description: This file defines React components for displaying statistics and properties of elements within the Excalidraw drawing application, including layout, scene, and element-specific stats, with support for custom stats rendering and UI interactions.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: Main React component for displaying overall stats panel.

classes.name: StatsRow
classes.description: Component representing a row in the stats display.

classes.name: StatsRows
classes.description: Component representing a collection of stats rows.

classes.name: StatsInner
classes.description: Memoized inner component handling detailed stats rendering and interactions.

methods.name: Stats
methods.description: Functional component that gathers app state and selected elements, renders StatsInner.

methods.name: StatsRow
methods.description: Component for rendering a single row of stats with optional heading and columns.

methods.name: StatsRows
methods.description: Component for rendering multiple StatsRow components.

methods.name: StatsInner
methods.description: Memoized component that renders detailed stats, handles UI interactions, and updates state.
